notes: Arcade dodge/platformer in pygame: a data unit jumps and moves to avoid falling corrupted-bit blocks, with gravity, a survival timer score (+1/sec), and game over on player-block collision. CLEAN: GPL-3.0; all sprites drawn in code with pygame.draw.rect; text via SysFont (no bundled TTF/OTF); no image/audio files; no EXE/DLL/LFS. ~92K. Claim #3907.
